page.layout: One page. Top: decorative woodcut ornament, then the title block (full width, centred). Below: the "AD LECTOREM." heading and an italic address to the reader (full width). Below that: two columns of index entries, left column then right column, each entry one line.

main_text.head: INDEX RERVM AC VERBORVM QVAE IN HIS INSTITVTIONIBVS ET ADIVNCTIS duobus Digestorum titulis tractantur, locupletissimus, compositus studio & diligentia P. C. B.
AD LECTOREM.

p.i: Observandum hic, amice lector, numerum non respondere foliis, sed legibus & paragraphis. Porrò, litera illa manuscula [?] vt A.B.C. &c. quæ post numeros legum vel paragraphorum subiiciuntur, ideo additæ sunt vt facilius id quod in margine adnotatum est inuestigari possit. Vale & boni consule.

main_text.l: Abauus abauia 4. gradum sunt §. 4. de gradib.
Abducere l. 7. in pr. A. de verb. signif.
Abesse l. 13 §. 1. & vlt. l. 14. in pr. l. 175. §. 1. l. 199. de verborum significatione.
Abnepos abneptis fratris & sororis 6. gradus sunt §. 6. de gradib.
Abnepos abneptis 4. gradus sunt §. 4. de gradib.
Abortiuus partus non nocet scriptis hæredibus §. 1. de exhæ-reu. liberor [?]
Absentia Reip. causa non nocet l. 140. §. 1. de reg. iur.
Absolui debet, qui pendente iudicio soluit §. 2. de pert & temp. actionib.
ad Absoluendum proniores sumus l. 125. M. de diuers. regul. iur.
Abundantia non vitiant scripturas l. 94. §. 1. de reg. iur.
ne Abutatur quis re sua inter est Reip. §. 2. de hiis qui sui vel alien.

page.notes: Right column entries 1–7 have been transcribed as printed, including the printed "Accegtilatio" corrected to "Acceptilatio"; the last line is at the foot of the scan and may continue beyond the cropped edge. Uncertain readings: "manuscula" in the address to the reader; the abbreviation after "exhæ-reu." in the entry "Abortiuus partus"; the first word of the address is a drop-cap O joined to "bservandum". No page number or running head is printed.
